description: This file implements a Flutter widget for a calculator screen. It includes state management, input handling, arithmetic operations, and UI layout for buttons and display, adapted from a Kotlin CalculatorActivity.

classes.name: CalculatorScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the calculator screen.

classes.name: _CalculatorScreenState
classes.description: Internal state class managing calculator logic and UI for CalculatorScreen.

methods.name: _resetAll
methods.description: Resets all calculator state variables to initial values.

methods.name: _parseInputBuffer
methods.description: Parses the input buffer string into a double value.

methods.name: _formatNumberForDisplay
methods.description: Formats a double value for display, removing unnecessary decimals or scientific notation.

methods.name: _setErrorState
methods.description: Sets the calculator into an error state, displaying 'Error'.

methods.name: _startNewEntry
methods.description: Starts a new input buffer with the specified initial string.

methods.name: _onDigit
methods.description: Handles digit button presses, updating the input buffer appropriately.

methods.name: _onDecimal
methods.description: Handles decimal point button press, adding a decimal if not already present.

methods.name: _applyPendingOperator
methods.description: Applies the current pending operator to the accumulator and operand.

methods.name: _onOperator
methods.description: Handles operator button presses, setting the pending operator.

methods.name: _onEquals
methods.description: Handles the equals button to compute the result based on the pending operator.

methods.name: _onClear
methods.description: Resets the calculator to its initial state.
